newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran says Annan to attend Tehran's Islamic summit.
newsitem.headline: Iran says Annan to attend Tehran's Islamic summit.

text.p: Iran said on Thursday U.N. Secretary-General Kofi Annan had accepted an invitation to attend an Islamic summit which Tehran plans to host in December.

The official Iranian news agency IRNA said Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati delivered the invitation to Annan in New York to attend the summit of the Organisation of the Islamic Conference (OIC), the Moslem world's biggest body.
"The U.N. Secretary-General accepted the invitation saying he would be in Tehran for the OIC summit," IRNA said.
